rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The destroyed peoples are generations from earlier ages.
rows.anchor: يعني بها من أهلكهم من القرون الماضية في الأعصر الخاليه

words: أفمن كان على بينة من ربه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bayyina means illumination, proof, and insight along a clear path.
rows.anchor: الضياء والحجة ، والاستبصار بواضح المحجة

words: أفمن كان على بينة من ربه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Scholars are illuminated by proof, while gnostics are illuminated by disclosure; the former see through foundational proofs and the latter through inspiration and arrival.
rows.anchor: فالعلماء في ضياء برهانهم ، والعارفون في ضياء بيانهم ؛ فهؤلاء بأحكام أدلة الأصول يبصرون

words: مثل الجنة التى وعد المتقون فيها أنهار
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise's rivers correspond to four spiritual drinks for God's friends: fidelity, purity, loyalty, and encounter; each has its own practice, intoxication, and sobriety.
rows.anchor: كذلك اليوم شأن الأولياء ، فهم شراب الوفاء ، ثم شراب الصفاء ، ثم شراب الولاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who drinks fidelity turns toward no one else during the beloved's absence.
rows.anchor: فمن تحسى شراب الوفاء لم ينظر إلى احد في ايام غيبته من أحبابه

words: وأنهار من لبن لم يتغير طعمه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drink of purity removes mixture; its drinker remains clear of self and its demands, without occupation or desire in either world.
rows.anchor: ومن شرب كأس الصفاء خلص له عن كل شوب ، فلا كدورة في عهده ، وهو في كل وقت صاف عن نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drink of loyalty leaves the drinker without rest and keeps the inner secret present without a moment's absence, by night or day.
rows.anchor: ومن شرب كأس الولاء عدم فيه القرار ، ولم يغب بسره لحظة في ليل أو نهار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drink of encounter gives constant intimacy with divine abiding, leaving no desire for another gift because the drinker is consumed in God's loftiness and majesty.
rows.anchor: فلم يطلب - مع بقائه - شيئا أخر من عطائه ؛ لاستهلاكه في علائه عند سطوات كبريائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites disliked what God revealed because it exposed them.
rows.anchor: هم المنافقون الذين كرهوا ما أنزل الله ؛ لما فيه من افتضاحهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who strive spiritually gain the lights of witnessing; those who contemplate proof gain the spirit of disclosure.
rows.anchor: اهتدوا } : بأنواع المجاهدات ، ( فزادهم هدى ) : بأنوار المشاهدات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guidance through reflection on proof is increased by the spirit of divine disclosure.
rows.anchor: اهتدوا } : بتأمل البرهان ، ( فزادهم هدى ) بروح البيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge of certainty is followed by the truth of certainty.
rows.anchor: اهتدوا } : بعلم اليقين ، ( فزادهم هدى ) : بحق اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The manners of intimate prayer lead to salvation and elevated ranks.
rows.anchor: اهتدوا } : بآداب المناجاة ، ( فزادهم هدى ) : بالنجاة ورفع الدرجات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who recognize the truth and do not dispute it receive further guidance through steadfastness on its paths.
rows.anchor: اهتدوا } : إلى ما فيه من الحق ولم يختلفوا في أنه الحق ، ( فزادهم هدى ) بالاستقامة على طرق الحق

words: فاعلم أنه لا إله إلا الله واستغفر لذنبك
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the Prophet already knew that there is no god but God, he was commanded to remain steadfast in that knowledge.
rows.anchor: كان عالما بأنه : { لا إله إلا الله } فامره بالثبات عليها

rows.speaker: محمد
rows.claim: The Prophet said he knew God best among the people and feared Him most.
rows.anchor: قال ( ص ) : ( أنا أعلمكم بالله ، وأخشاكم له )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A gnostic is occupied with witnessing the Real rather than creatures, and is not even free to attend to the self, much less spy on others.
rows.anchor: وهو لا يتفرغ إلى نفسه فكيف إلى غيره ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Backbiting people results only from being absent from the Real.
rows.anchor: لا تحصل الغيبة للخلق إلا من الغيبة عن الحق

words: أيحب أحدكم أن يأكل لحم أخيه ميتا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Exegetes take eating a dead brother's flesh as backbiting, which is also the verse's apparent meaning.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير أن المقصود بذلك الغيبة ، وعلى ذلك يدل ظاهر الآية

words: أيحب أحدكم أن يأكل لحم أخيه ميتا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating carrion marks someone as among the basest and least valued of disbelievers.
rows.anchor: وأخس الكفار وأقلهم قدرا من يأكل الميتة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is rare to encounter someone who does not backbite when speaking in your presence.
rows.anchor: وعزيز رؤية من لا يغتاب أحدا بين يديك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All people descend from Adam and Eve and were divided into peoples and tribes for mutual recognition, not boasting or rivalry.
rows.anchor: إنا خلقناكم أجمعكم من آدم وحواء ، ثم جعناكم شعوبا وقبائل لتعارفوا لا لتكاثروا ولا لتنافسوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no basis for pride in origins that reduce to earth, semen, or a clot, nor in what one's visible form conceals.
rows.anchor: فإذا كانت الأصول تربة ونطفة وعلقة . . فالتفاخر بماذا ؟ أبا لحمأ المسنون ؟ أم بالنطفة في قرار مكين ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A saying that people's traces identify them urges the reader to look at their traces after they are gone.
rows.anchor: وقد قيل : إن آثارنا تدل علينا . . . فانظروا بعدنا إلى الآثار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ostentatious deeds, self-admiring states, and treacherous dealings cannot ground a claim to nobility.
rows.anchor: أم بأفعالك التي هي بالرياء مشوبة ؟ أم بأحوالك التي هي بالإعجاب مصحوبة ؟ أم بمعاملاتك التي هي ملأى بالخيانة ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Piety means release from the self, its cravings, and its claims; the noblest servant is farthest from self and nearest to God.
rows.anchor: أتقاكم أي أبعدكم عن نفسه ، فالتقوى هي التحرر من النفس وأطماعها وحظوظها

words: ءامنا قل لم تؤمنوا ولكن قولوا أسلمنا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faith is the heart's life, and the heart lives only after the self is slain; the self does not die but recedes, and its presence prevents good.
rows.anchor: الإيمان هو حياة القلب ، والقلب لا يحيا إلا بعد ذبح النفس ، والنفوس لا تموت ولكنها تغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outward submission is Islam, but outwardly submitting does not guarantee inward sincerity.
rows.anchor: والاستسلام في الظاهر إسلام . وليس كل من استسلم ظاهرا مخلص في سره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse locates faith in the heart, as the description of hypocrites locates illness there; illness and faith are opposites.
rows.anchor: في هذا دليل على أن محل الإيمان القلب . كما أنه في وصف المنافقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The restriction إنما makes the listed qualities necessary for faith and excludes the claim of anyone who lacks them.
rows.anchor: وهي للتحقيق الذي يقتضي طرد العكس ؛ فمن خرج عن هذه الشرائط التي جعلها للإيمان فمردود عليه قوله

words: إنما المؤمنون الذين ءامنوا بالله ورسوله
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faith should give the servant security; one whose faith brings no security is more properly described by something other than faith.
rows.anchor: والإيمان يوجب للعبد الأمان ، فما لم يكن الإيمان موجبا للأمان فصاحبه بغيره أولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Religious judgments must be grounded in revelation: names are derived from it, rulings sought from it, and its commands followed.
rows.anchor: فالأسامي منه تؤخذ ، والأحكام منه تطلب ، وأوامره متبعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Attributing one's deeds and states to oneself is associating partners with God, while claiming them for oneself is deceit; neither can support boasting.
rows.anchor: من لاحظ شيئا من أعماله وأحواله فإن رآها من نفسه كان شركا ، وإن رآها لنفسه كان مكرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant must accept God's favor as its true source; it is disgraceful for one who owes this favor to claim superiority over another.
rows.anchor: والذي يجب عليه قبول المنة . . كيف يرى لنفسه على غيره منة ؟ !

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only God is the benefactor; a favor is truly a favor when the servant is truthful, while a flaw in the servant makes it a trial.
rows.anchor: بل المنة لله ؛ فهو ولي النعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human favor taints a kindness, whereas God's favor makes the blessing wholesome.
rows.anchor: والمنة نكدر الصنيع إذا كانت من المخلوقين ، ولكن بالمنة تطيب النعمة إذا كانت من قبل الله

words: إن الله يعلم غيب السماوات والأرض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who halts at the unseen knowledge of heaven and earth finds life troubled, since he does not know what hidden fate holds for him; the author cites a poem fearing separation.
rows.anchor: ومن وقف ها هنا تكدر عليه عيشه ؛ إذ ليس يدري ما غيبه فيه ، وفي معنى هذا قول القائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs remind each returning servant to move from witnessing divine acts to seeing attributes, then to witnessing God's reality and essence.
rows.anchor: علامة ودلالة لكل من أناب إلينا ، ورجع من شهود أفعالنا إلى رؤية صفاتنا ، ومن شهود صفاتنا إلى شهود حقنا وذاتنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Blessed water is abundant in benefit and increase.
rows.anchor: أنزلنا من السماء ماء مباركا كثير النفع والزيادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The harvestable grain is what is cut down, as in the phrase masjid al-jāmiʿ.
rows.anchor: أي الذي يحصد - كما تقول مسجد الجامع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The created components are alike, but differ in taste, scent, color, form, and measure.
rows.anchor: الأجزاء متجانسة . . ولكن أوصافها في الطعوم والروائح والألوان والهيئات والمقادير مختلفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The palms are tall, and their fruit clusters are layered one above another, either from abundant spadices or fruit.
rows.anchor: والنخل باسقات : طويلات ، لها طلع منضود بعضه فوق بعض لكثرة الطلع أو لما فيها من الثمار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made some fruits dispersed, like apples and pears, and others gathered, like grapes and dates, as provision for people to benefit from.
rows.anchor: وكيف جعلنا بعض الثمار متفرقة كالتفاح والكمثرى وغيرهما ، وكيف جعلنا بعضها مجتمعة كالعنب والرطب

words: وأحيينا به بلدة ميتا كذلك الخروج
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as God sends water to revive dry land, He can gather people for resurrection; raising the dead is no more difficult than reviving the land.
rows.anchor: وكما سقنا هذا الماء إلى بلدة جف نباتها ، وكما فعلنا كل هذه الأشياء ونحن قادرون على ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The named earlier peoples were not beyond God's power to destroy; their fate warns the deniers and consoles the Messenger.
rows.anchor: وفيه تهديد لهم وتسلة للرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God was not incapable or wearied by the first creation, so recreating people cannot be difficult for Him.
rows.anchor: إنا لم نعجز عن الخلق الأول . . فكيف نعجز عن الخلق الثاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul whispers desires to satisfy itself, including affectation before people, bad character, rancor, and other afflictions that disturb the heart and its time.
rows.anchor: نعلم ما توسوس به نفسه من شهوات تطلب استنفاذها ، مثل التصنع مع الخلق ، وسوء الخلق ، والحقد

words: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The vein is the nearest part of a person to himself; the verse means God's knowledge and power, His hearing of speech, and that no affair is unclear to Him.
rows.anchor: فحبل الوريد أقرب أجزاء نفسه إلى نفسه ، والمراد من ذلك العلم والقدرة ، وأنه يسمع قولهم

words: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This verse brings awe, panic, and fear to some, but spirit, tranquility, and intimacy of heart to others.
rows.anchor: وفي هذه الآية هيبة وفزع وخوف لقوم ، وروح وسكون وأنس قلب لقوم

rows.speaker: الملك الموكل
rows.claim: The assigned recording angel says he did not hasten the man into a slip and only wrote it after he committed it, answering the unbeliever's claim that the record was premature.
rows.anchor: يقول الملك من الحفظة الموكل له : ما أعجلته على الزلة

rows.speaker: الشيطان
rows.claim: Alternatively, the companion is the paired Satan, who says in Hell that he did not compel the man's disbelief; the man chose what Satan whispered.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هو الشيطان المقرون به ، وحين يلتقيان في جهنم يقول الشيطان : ما أكرهته على كفره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forbids them to dispute before Him, since He had commanded right conduct and forbidden error and had already given warning.
rows.anchor: لا تختصموا لدي اليوم وقد أمرتكم بالرشد ونهيتكم عن الغي

words: هل امتلأت وتقول هل من مزيد
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exchange with Hell uses figurative speech; God gives it life to speak, for otherwise it could not answer.
rows.anchor: القول هنا على التوسع ؛ لأنه لو كانت جهنم ممن يجيب لقالت ذلك بل يحييها حتى تقول ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question is a threatening intensification directed at the unbelievers and a demand for further increase.
rows.anchor: على جهة التغليظ ، والاستزداة من الكفار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative takes the question to mean no increase remains, like the Prophet's answer that ʿAqīl had left no house for them in Mecca.
rows.anchor: كقوله عليه السلام لما قيل له : يوم فتح مكة : هل ترجع إلى دارك

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Asked at the conquest of Mecca whether he would return home, the Prophet asked whether ʿAqīl had left them a house, meaning he had not.
rows.anchor: قوله عليه السلام لما قيل له : يوم فتح مكة : هل ترجع إلى دارك ؟ فقال : ( وهل ترك لنا عقيل دارا )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fills Hell with unbelievers and sinners; when sinful believers are removed, the unbelievers' rage increases until Hell is filled with them.
rows.anchor: فإن الله - تعالى - يملأ جهنم من الكفار والعصاة ، فإذا ما أخرج العصاة من المؤمنين ازداد غيظ الكفار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation is that Paradise itself is brought near to the pious, just as Hell is dragged in chains toward the criminals.
rows.anchor: يقال : أن الجنة تقرب من المتقين ، كما أن النار تجر بالسلاسل إلى المحشر نحو المجرمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation is that their gathering to Paradise is made easy; this is said of the special elect.
rows.anchor: ويقال : بل تقرب الجنة بأن يسهل على المتقين حشرهم إليها . . . وهم خواص الخواص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There are three groups: ordinary believers walk to Paradise, the elect ride their personified acts of obedience, and the elect of the elect have Paradise brought near to them.
rows.anchor: هم ثلاثة أصناف : قوم يحشرون إلى الجنة مشاة وهم الذين قال فيهم : { وسيق الذين اتقوا ربهم إلى الجنة زمرا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect ride their personified acts of obedience, while the elect of the elect are those for whom Paradise itself is brought near.
rows.anchor: وقوم يحشرون إلى الجنة ركبانا على طاعاتهم المصورة لهم بصورة حيوان ، وهم الذين قال فيهم جل وعلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The invocation captivates a gnostic's heart through the unveiling of divine majesty and honors a discontented heart through gracious kindness, though it does not conquer every heart or remove every distress.
rows.anchor: ' بسم الله ' كلمة ما استولت على قلب عارف إلا تيمه بكشف جلاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Tur is the mountain where God spoke to Moses, the place where beloved servants heard the address.
rows.anchor: والظور هو الجبل الذي كلم عليه موسى عليه السلام ؛ لأنه محل قدم الأحباب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the Tur, Moses heard Muhammad and his community mentioned and God called them while they were still in their fathers' loins, saying He had granted them before they asked.
rows.anchor: ولأنه الموضع الذي سمع فيه موسى ذكرمحمد وذكر أمته حتى نادانا ونحن في أصلاب آبائنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God swears by the opening objects, and the oath's answer is that the Lord's punishment will surely occur.
rows.anchor: أقسم الله بهذه الأشياء ( التي في مطلع السورة ) ، وجواب القسم قوله : { إن عذاب ربك لواقع }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The written book can mean the Qur'an written in codices or the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: مكتوب في المصاحف ، وفي اللوح المحفوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies the book as the angels' book in heaven from which they read what was and will be.
rows.anchor: وقيل : كتاب الملائكة في السماء يقرؤون منه ما كان وما يكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view takes it to be what God wrote for Himself concerning mercy to His servants.
rows.anchor: ويقال : ما كتب على نفسه من الرحمة لعباده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies it with God's statement that His mercy preceded His wrath.
rows.anchor: سبقت رحمتي غضبي ) . ويقال : هو قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view refers to the written promise that God's righteous servants will inherit the earth.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هو قوله : { ولقد كتبنا فى الزبور من بعد الذكر أن الأرض يرثها عبادى الصالحون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view is the record of deeds given to servants in their right or left hands on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الكتاب المسطور فيه أعمال العباد يعطى لعباده بأيمانهم وشمائلهم يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase in an unrolled parchment refers back to the written book just described.
rows.anchor: يرجع إلى ما ذكرنا من الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inhabited house is in the fourth heaven.
rows.anchor: في السماء الرابعة ويقال : هو قلوب العباد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, it is the hearts of gnostics inhabited by love and knowledge.
rows.anchor: المعمورة بمحبته ومعرفته . ويقال : هي مواضع عبادتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies it as places of worship and private retreats.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هي مواضع عبادتهم ومجالس خلواتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies it as the Kaaba.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الكعبة . { والسقف المرفوع }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The raised roof is the sky.
rows.anchor: والسقف المرفوع } . هي السماء . وقيل سماء هممهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, it is the sky of their aspirations in the realm.
rows.anchor: وقيل سماء هممهم في الملكوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surging sea means seas that are filled.
rows.anchor: البحار المملوءة . أقسم بهذه الأشياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The punishment is outwardly what God threatened for the disobedient, and inwardly the veil after presence, covering after unveiling, and rejection after acceptance.
rows.anchor: وعذابه في الظاهر ما توعد به عباده العاصين ، وفي الباطن الحجاب بعد الحضور ، والستر بعد الكشف ، والرد بعد القبول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once God rejects a servant, the decree of rejection is settled and cannot be reversed; the author illustrates this with a verse about the soul turning away.
rows.anchor: إذا رد عبدا أبرم القضاء برده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sky will revolve with everything within it, and the mountains will move from their places.
rows.anchor: أي تدور بما فيها ، وتسير الجبال عن أماكنها ، فتسير سيرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Woe is an Arabic word used for someone who has fallen into ruin.
rows.anchor: الويل كلمة تقولها العرب لمن وقع في الهلاك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They plunge into the falsehood of denial.
rows.anchor: في باطل التكذيب يخوضون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The name is forbearing: God knows and conceals what He sees, forgives, and measures punishment; He sees and hides, knows and does not disclose.
rows.anchor: ' بسم الله ' اسم حليم فيما يعلم ويستر ما يبصر ويغفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The star that sets may refer to the Pleiades.
rows.anchor: والثريا إذا سقط وغرب . ويقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view takes the oath to concern the class of stars in general.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هو جنس النجوم أقسم بها . ويقال : هي الكواكب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view takes the stars to mean the planets.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هي الكواكب . ويقال : أقسم بنجوم القرآن على النبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies them as the Qur'an's portions revealed to the Prophet.
rows.anchor: أقسم بنجوم القرآن على النبي صلى الله عيله وسلم ويقال هي الكواكب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies them as the heavenly bodies hurled at devils.
rows.anchor: ويقال هي الكواكب التي ترمى بها الشياطين . ويقال أقسم بالنبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says God swears by the Prophet on his return from the Ascension.
rows.anchor: ويقال أقسم بالنبي عند منصرفه من المعراج . ويقال : أقسم بضياء قلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An inward view identifies the stars as lights of gnostics' hearts and stars of seekers' intellects.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أقسم بضياء قلوب العارفين ونجوم عقول الطالبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet never strayed from monotheism, and ghayy is the opposite of right guidance.
rows.anchor: الغي : نقيض الرشد . . وفي هذا تخصيص للنبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God directly defends the Prophet here, unlike Noah and Hud who answered their accusers themselves, or Moses who rebuked Pharaoh.
rows.anchor: وفي هذا تخصيص للنبي حيث تولى - سبحانه - الذب عنه فيما رمي به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet never lost awareness of witnessing, even for an instant.
rows.anchor: ما ضل صاحبكم ، ولا غفل عن الشهود طرفة عين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet does not speak from desire; the Qur'an is revelation sent down.
rows.anchor: أي ما ينطق بالهوى ، وما هذا القرآن إلا وحي يوحى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God testifies directly for Muhammad here, unlike His command to David to judge justly and not follow desire.
rows.anchor: وفي هذا أيضا تخصيص له بالشهادة ؛ إذ قال لداود : { فاحكم بين الناس بالحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is bridled by piety outwardly, sheltered by God inwardly, cleansed of human blemish, raised to witnessing oneness, and wholly seized by divine majesty.
rows.anchor: في الظاهر مزموم بزمام التقوى ، وفي السرائر في إيواء المولى ، مصفى عن كدورات البشرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one of mighty powers who taught him is Gabriel.
rows.anchor: أي جبريل عليه السلام . و { ذو مرة } : أي ذو قوة وهو جبريل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dhū mirra means possessing strength.
rows.anchor: ذو مرة } : أي ذو قوة وهو جبريل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one at the highest horizon is Gabriel.
rows.anchor: وهو بالأفق الأعلى } أي جبريل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel drew near to Muhammad and descended from above to him.
rows.anchor: دنا جبريل من محمد عليه السلام . فتدلى جبريل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative says tadallā indicates greater closeness, with Muhammad approaching his Lord in honored nearness; here it can mean prostration.
rows.anchor: وقيل : ( تدلى ) تفيد الزيادة في القرب ، وأن محمدا عليه السلام هو الذي دنا من ربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad drew near to his Lord through subtle, abundant knowledge placed within him, then surrendered with a tranquil heart to what drew him near.
rows.anchor: ويقال : دنا محمد من ربه بما أودع من لطائف المعرفة وزوائدها ، فتدلى بسكون قلبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel in his actual form was from Muhammad at a distance of two bows or nearer.
rows.anchor: فكان جبريل - وهو في صورته التي هو عليها - من محمد بحيث كان بينهما قدر قوسين أو أدنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation places Muhammad two bows from God in a nearness of honor, not physical distance.
rows.anchor: ويقال : كان بينه - - وبين الله قدر قوسين : أراد به دنو كرامة لا دنو مسافة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two bows invoke an Arab custom of touching bows to confirm intimacy and alliance, and revelation uses the familiar expression.
rows.anchor: ويقال : كان من عادتهم إذا أرادوا تحقيق الألفة بينهم إلصاق أحدهم قوسه بقوس صاحبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase or nearer raises the degree of nearness beyond the preceding comparison, meaning rather nearer.
rows.anchor: ثم رفع الله هذا فقال : { أو أدنى } أي بل أدنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God revealed to Muhammad what He revealed.
rows.anchor: أي أوحى الله إلى محمد ما أوحى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One view says God gave Muhammad burdens or secrets that He disclosed to no one else.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أحمله أحمالا لم يطلع عليها أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view gives the revelation as God's reminders that He sheltered the Prophet as an orphan, guided him, and enriched him.
rows.anchor: ويقال : قال له : ألم أجدك يتيما فآويتك ؟ ألم أجدك ضالا فهديتك ؟ ألم أجدك عائلا فأغنيتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says God gave him glad tidings of the Basin and Kawthar.
rows.anchor: ويقال : بشره بالحوض والكوثر . ويقال : أوحى إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says Paradise is forbidden to prophets until Muhammad enters it and to nations until his community enters it.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أوحى إليه أن الجنة محرمة على الأنبياء حتى تدخلها ، وعلى الأمم حتى تدخلها أمتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All those explanations are sound, but there were also other things in the encounter that no one was shown.
rows.anchor: والأولى أن يقال : هذا الذي قالوه كله حسن ، وغيره مما لم يطلع أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: That night was uniquely Muhammad's: God raised him to an unmatched station, drew him near, and kept their secret from every observer.
rows.anchor: إذ رقاه إلى ما رقاه ، ولقاه بما لقاه ، وأدناه حيث لا دنو قبله ولا بعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad's heart did not deny the signs his eyes saw.
rows.anchor: ما كذب فؤاد محمد ما رآه ببصره من الآيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is also said that Muhammad saw his Lord that night in the manner he had known before seeing Him.
rows.anchor: رأى ربه تلك الليلة على الوصف الذي علمه قبل أن يراه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question asks whether they dispute with him about what he sees.
rows.anchor: أفتجادلونه على ما يرى ؟ قوله جل ذكره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author says Gabriel saw God once again while Muhammad was at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary.
rows.anchor: أي جبريل رأى الله مرة أخرى حين كان محمد عند سدرة المنتهى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lote Tree is in Paradise and marks the limit of the angels.
rows.anchor: وهي شجرة في الجنة ، وهي منتهى الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other views say the tree is where the souls of martyrs, or the souls of all creatures, end; no one knows what lies beyond it except God.
rows.anchor: تنتهي إليها أرواح الخلق ، ولا يعلم ما وراءها إلا الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Garden of Refuge there is one of the gardens.
rows.anchor: وهي جنة من الجنان . قوله جل ذكره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tree is covered by angels in a number known only to God.
rows.anchor: يغشاها ما يغشاها من الملائكة ما الله أعلم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says green bird-like coverings or wings envelop the tree.
rows.anchor: وفي خبر : ( يغشاها رفرف طير خضر )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The invocation gives light to hearts and eyes and joy to spirits and secrets; it points to God's majesty and the perfection of His favors and kindnesses.
rows.anchor: ' بسم الله ' كلمة بها نور القلوب والأبصار ، وبعرفانها يحصل سرور الأرواح والأسرار

rows.speaker: أهل التفسير
rows.claim: Exegetes agree that the moon split during the Prophet's lifetime.
rows.anchor: أجمع أهل التفسير على أن القمر قد انشق على عهد الرسول

rows.speaker: ابن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud reported seeing Mount Hira between the two halves of the moon.
rows.anchor: قال ابن مسعود : ( رأيت حراء بين فلقتي القمر ) ولم يوجد لابن مسعود مخالف

rows.speaker: أنس وابن عمر وحذيفة وابن عباس وجبير بن مطعم
rows.claim: Anas, Ibn Umar, Hudhayfa, Ibn Abbas, and Jubayr ibn Mutim also transmitted the report.
rows.anchor: فقد روي أيضا عن أنس وابن عمر وحذيفة وابن عباس وجبير بن مطعم . . كلهم رووا هذا الخبر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The miracle has two aspects: witnesses saw it, and its concealment from those who did not see it violated what normally could not be hidden.
rows.anchor: وفيه إعجاز من وجهين : أحدهما رؤية من رأى ذلك ، والثاني خفاء مثل ذلك على من لم يره

rows.speaker: أهل مكة
rows.claim: The people of Mecca saw the split and said Muhammad had bewitched the moon.
rows.anchor: وأهل مكة رأوا ذلك ، وقالوا : إن محمدا قد سحر القمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The time remaining before the Resurrection is short compared with the time already elapsed.
rows.anchor: ومعنى { اقتربت الساعة } : أي ما بقي من الزمان إلى القيامة إلا قليل بالإضافة إلى ما مضى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the Meccans see a sign, they turn away from examining it; had they considered it, knowledge would necessarily follow.
rows.anchor: يعني أن أهل مكة إذا رأوا آية من الآيات أعرضوا عن النظر فيها ، ولو نظروا لحصل لهم العلم واجبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mustamir can mean lasting, powerful, and severe.
rows.anchor: أي دائم قوي شديد . . . ويقال إنهم قالوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says the Meccans meant that the magic would pass away, taking istamar to mean that it went.
rows.anchor: ويقال إنهم قالوا : هذا ذاهب لا تبقى مدته فاستمر : أي ذهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Following desire brings denial because God veils the heart from right insight, while following truth opens inner sight and produces assent.
rows.anchor: فإذا حصل اتباع الهوى فمن شؤمه يحصل التكذيب ؛ لأن الله يلبس على قلب صاحبه حتى لا يستبصر الرشد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every person's allotted fate comes to pass; the believer's settled deed leads to Paradise, while the unbeliever's settled deed brings recompense.
rows.anchor: يستقر عمل المؤمن فتوجب له الجنة ، ويستقر عمل الكافر فيجازى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reports about earlier prophets, peoples, and ages should have deterred them, but ignorance veiled their insight and blinded them to guidance.
rows.anchor: جاءهم من أخبار الأنبياء والأمم الذين من قبلهم والأزمنة الماضية ما يجب أن يحصل به الارتداع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hikma baligha is an appositive to the earlier word mā.
rows.anchor: بدل من ( ما ) فيما سبق : ( ما فيه مزدجر )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mature wisdom is sound, manifest, and clear to anyone who reflects.
rows.anchor: والحكمةالبالغة هي الصحيحة الظاهرة الواضحة لمن تفكر فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's name is overpowering: He brings the attentive near through grace, may remove choice from one persisting in disobedience, and can compel obedience through affliction.
rows.anchor: من اعتنى بشأنه أحضره بإحسانه ، فإن أبى إلا تماديا في عصيانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The name describes God as eternal, self-subsisting, one, and matchless in beauty and majesty; He is the ally of believers and kind even to sinful believers.
rows.anchor: اسم عزيز أزلي ، جبار صمدي ، قهار أحدى ، للمؤمنين ولي ، وبالعاصين حفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the Resurrection occurs, nothing can repel it.
rows.anchor: إذا قامت القيامة لا يردها شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kādhiba is a verbal noun like ʿāfiya and ʿāqiba; the event is true and cannot be turned back, with no falsehood in its coming.
rows.anchor: أي : هي حقة لا يدرها شيء ، وليس في وقوعها كذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person on the path of soundness and uprightness reaches safety and honor; whoever deviates meets regret and loss, and the event distinguishes truth from pretense.
rows.anchor: ويقال : إذا وقعت الواقعة فمن سلك منهاج الصحة والاستقامة وصل إلى السلامة ولقي الكرامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poem says that when tears mingle on faces, one can distinguish a genuine mourner from someone pretending to weep.
rows.anchor: إذا اشتبكت دموع في خدود . . . تبين من بكى ممن تباكى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Event lowers the wretched and raises those in accord.
rows.anchor: لأهل الشقاوة ، { رافعة } : لأهل الوفاق . { خافضة }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It lowers the egos and raises the hearts.
rows.anchor: للنفوس ، { رافعة } : للقلوب . { خافضة } لأهل الشهوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It lowers people ruled by appetite and raises people of spiritual purity.
rows.anchor: لأهل الشهوة ، { رافعة } : لأهل الصفوة . { خافضة }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It lowers those who deny and raises those who affirm God's unity.
rows.anchor: خافضة } : لمن جحد ، { رافعة } : لمن وحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth will be shaken with a violent movement.
rows.anchor: حركت حركة شديدة . قوله جل ذكره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains will be crushed until scattered dust, like particles seen in a shaft of sunlight.
rows.anchor: فتتت فكانت كالهباء الذي يقع في الكوة عند شعاع الشمس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about the people of the right magnifies their stature and honor; they are people of blessing and reward.
rows.anchor: على جهته التفخيم لشأنهم والتعظيم لقدرهم وهم أصحاب اليمن والبركة والثواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about the people of the left magnifies their condemnation; they bring misfortune upon themselves.
rows.anchor: على جهة التعظيم والمبالغة في ذمهم ، وهم أصحاب الشؤم على أنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One view identifies the two groups with the right and left sides of Adam at the primordial covenant.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أصحاب الميمنة هم الذين كانوا في جانب اليمين من آدم عليه السلام يوم الذر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies them as those given their records in their right or left hands.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الذين يعطون الكتاب بأيمانهم ، والذين يعطون الكتاب بشمائلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says the groups are led rightward to Paradise or leftward to Hell.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هم الذين يؤخذ بهم ذات اليمين . . إلى الجنة ، والذين يؤخذ بهم ذات الشمال . . إلى النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forerunners form the third group and lead in praiseworthy qualities and acts of excellence.
rows.anchor: وهم الصف الثالث . وهم السابقون إلى الخصال الحميدة ، والأفضال الجميلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other views say they were first in emigration, Islam, the five prayers, sincerity, high aspiration, or every good deed.
rows.anchor: ويقال : السابقون إلى الهجرة . ويقال : إلى الإسلام . ويقال : إلى الصلوات الخمس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One view calls forerunners those who hasten to repent and regret their sins.
rows.anchor: المتسارعون إلى التوبة من الذنوب فيتسارعون إلى الندم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies them as those whom God promised the highest reward and who hastened to the good allotted to them.
rows.anchor: الذين سبقت لهم من الله الحسنى فسبقوا إلى ما سبق إليه
